ops.title: Metal VM 48 GB sizing constraint
ops.body: Measured (2026-07 qmlx/Rapid-MLX evaluation, spikes on the live guest): a 32 GB metal guest (~26 GB GPU wired cap via hw.memsize-6GB) thrashes any always-resident 20 GB MLX model — 0.025 tok/s decode, 19.5 min cold load, and a qmlx-printed macOS kernel-panic warning (107% projected utilization). omlx only fit by idle-unloading. At 48 GB (~42 GB cap) the same model loads in ~64 s, decodes 8.6 tok/s (omlx) / 7.9 (qmlx), and coexists with the granite STT model. The live VM was resized in place with tart set metal --memory 49152; the wired cap tracks guest RAM automatically (darwin/metal.nix postActivation).
ops.when: when considering VM resource changes for model inference or evaluating performance degradation
